metadata.article_title: Penalty for failure to collect tax at source.

article.title: Penalty for failure to collect tax at source.
article.content:
271CAPenalty for failure to collect tax at source.

Section 271CA  ·  Chapter XXI  ·  page 973 of the Act
(1) If any person fails to collect the whole or any part of the tax as required by or under the provisions of Chapter XVII-BB, then, such person shall be liable to pay, by way of penalty, a sum equal to the amount of tax which such person failed to collect as aforesaid.
(2) Any penalty imposable under sub-section (1) shall be imposed by the Joint Commissioner:
11[Provided that any penalty under sub-section (1), on or after the 1st day of April, 2025, shall be imposed by the Assessing Officer.]
11 Ins. by Act No. 7 of 2025, w.e.f. 1-4-2025.
